sentences.text: Michael Andrew Fox , OC -LRB- born June 9 , 1961 -RRB- , known professionally as Michael J. Fox , is a Canadian-American actor , author , producer , and activist .	OC	Order of Canada	Canadian-American	Canadian American

With a film and television career spanning from the 1970s , Fox is best known for such roles as Mike Flaherty on the ABC sitcom Spin City -LRB- 1996 -- 2000 -RRB- , for which he won an Emmy , three Golden Globes , and two Screen Actors Guild Awards .	Mike Flaherty	Mike Flaherty (Deputy Mayor)	ABC	American Broadcasting Corporation	sitcom	sitcom	Spin City	Spin City	Emmy	Emmy Award	Golden Globes	Golden Globe Awards	Screen Actors Guild Awards	Screen Actors Guild Awards

Other notable roles have included Marty McFly from the Back to the Future trilogy -LRB- 1985 -- 1990 -RRB- ; and Alex P. Keaton from NBC 's Family Ties -LRB- 1982 -- 1989 -RRB- , for which he won three Emmys and a Golden Globe .	Marty McFly	Marty McFly	Alex P. Keaton	Alex P. Keaton	NBC	NBC	Family Ties	Family Ties
Fox was diagnosed with Parkinson 's disease in 1991 , at age 29 , and disclosed his condition to the public in 1998 .
Fox semi-retired from acting in 2000 as the symptoms of his disease worsened .

He has since become an advocate for research toward finding a cure ; he created the Michael J. Fox Foundation , and on March 5 , 2010 , Sweden 's Karolinska Institutet gave him a honoris causa doctorate for his work in advocating a cure for Parkinson 's disease .	Michael J. Fox Foundation	The Michael J. Fox Foundation	Karolinska Institutet	Karolinska Institutet

Since 1999 , Fox has mainly worked as a voice-over actor in films such as Stuart Little and Disney 's Atlantis : The Lost Empire .	voice-over	voice-over	Stuart Little	Stuart Little (film)	Disney	Disney
On the CBS TV show The Good Wife , he earned Emmy nominations for three consecutive years for his recurring role as crafty attorney Louis Canning .	Emmy	Emmy Award	CBS	CBS	The Good Wife	The Good Wife

Fox has also taken recurring guest roles and cameo appearances in Boston Legal , Scrubs , Curb Your Enthusiasm and Rescue Me .	Boston Legal	Boston Legal	Scrubs	Scrubs (TV series)	Curb Your Enthusiasm	Curb Your Enthusiasm	Rescue Me	Rescue Me (U.S. TV series)

He has released three books : Lucky Man : A Memoir -LRB- 2002 -RRB- , Always Looking Up : The Adventures of an Incurable Optimist -LRB- 2009 -RRB- , and A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Future : Twists and Turns and Lessons Learned -LRB- 2010 -RRB- .
He was appointed an Officer of the Order of Canada in 2010 .	Order of Canada	Order of Canada
He also was inducted into Canada 's Walk of Fame in 2000 .
